commercial_facts.approved_public_skus: All 239 catalog records remain eligible for public catalog projection subject to the field-level truth controls below and the owner decision for shared access.
commercial_facts.approved_public_prices: AIPS-owned BDT catalog prices in data/products.json may be displayed as AIPS prices. They are not represented as current provider MSRP or discounts. Exact order price is re-confirmed before payment; per-record verificationDate coverage is still incomplete and remains audit debt.
commercial_facts.approved_access_models: Personal, bundle and service catalog labels may be shown. Shared access remains owner-approved for public sale by the 2026-08-10 decision, while provider/ToS classification remains unresolved and must not be represented as vendor-authorized.
commercial_facts.approved_payment_facts: bKash and Nagad are approved public payment references. Do not infer blanket support for every local/international payment method and never request passwords, PINs or OTPs.
commercial_facts.approved_delivery_facts: Confirm current availability and delivery ETA for the exact order before payment. Legacy deliverySLA, estimatedDeliveryTime, deliveryMethod and stock fields are deprecated as public commercial facts until re-verified.
commercial_facts.approved_warranty_refund_facts: No blanket warranty, refund, replacement period or guaranteed resolution outcome is approved site-wide. Resolution is order-specific under the current Refund & Resolution Policy and the terms confirmed for the exact order.
commercial_facts.approved_social_proof: 10,000+ customers since 2022 is CEO-attested. Product ratings, review counts and fabricated review/aggregate-rating structured data are not verified and must not be rendered.

public_projection_policy.blocked_field_behavior: Remove or neutralize in the generated public projection even when commerce publication is allowed. Raw catalog retention is audit debt, not publication authority.
public_projection_policy.quarantine_behavior: Fail closed by stripping all protected commercial fields, prices and access models as already enforced by the informational-fail-closed projection.

catalog_snapshot.note: Missing-evidence counts treat both absent and null values as unknown. These counts intentionally remain visible. Do not populate synthetic values merely to make validator warnings disappear.

legacy_claim_occurrences.scope: raw catalog plus source pages reported by validate-catalog.mjs; public renderers have separate truth guards

owner_decisions.decision: Restore all 44 accessType:"shared" SKUs to public sale, overriding the AIPS-P0-20260810-COMMERCE-COMPLIANCE-DRIFT quarantine before per-vendor ToS reconciliation was completed.
owner_decisions.risk_disclosed: Shared-account access may conflict with affected vendors' terms. Provider-side detection can result in account suspension, customer disputes, chargebacks or vendor action against AIPS. This risk was disclosed before the owner directed restoration.
owner_decisions.scope: All 44 shared SKUs. Per-vendor ToS and authorization classification remains open and unresolved; this decision authorizes AIPS publication/sale but does not create provider authorization or close the evidence gap.

rule: Unknown protected facts remain unknown. Agents must not infer or backfill delivery SLAs, warranty/refund periods, ratings, review counts, vendor authorization, provider entitlements, discounts or other protected commercial claims from old pages, stale pull requests, historical docs or raw legacy fields. Explicit scoped owner decisions may authorize AIPS business actions, but they do not convert provider-controlled facts into verified provider facts.
